name: wayfinder
description: Walkable neighborhood trip architect with live weather, currency rates, interactive maps, and .ics/.trip editors.

interface.longDescription: Wayfinder combines zero-key open travel data (OpenStreetMap, Open-Meteo, Frankfurter FX, Wikimedia Commons) with interactive neighborhood maps, a live thread itinerary tray, and a desktop .trip/.ics file editor.
defaultPrompt: Plan a walkable 3-day Kyoto neighborhood itinerary with live weather and JPY->USD budget
Explore walkable cafes and museums in Lisbon Baixa on the interactive map
Audit my saved Kyoto trip for rainy-day indoor swaps and export a .ics file
